response.rationale: Mechanical leader_score is a near-tie (0.2755 vs 0.3003, ~9% relative gap) and noisy. The slot1_share_7d evidence clearly favours C-S1-HYD: it holds 94% of slot-1 impressions vs 59% for C-S3-HYD, making it the incumbent auction winner. Protecting C-S1-HYD's bid preserves top-slot coverage; making C-S3-HYD the leader would invite internal bid competition against the dominant sibling for the same keyword in HYD.
